cases.title: PO-only native release
cases.given: Authorized native PO reaches purchase without SO, transaction or load
cases.positive_expected: One supplier issue request/queued mail; no fake other records
cases.negative_counterexample: Draft/import/confirmation replay sends none

cases.title: SO-only native release
cases.given: Native SO confirmation completes without PO/load
cases.positive_expected: One buyer issue; independent of PO
cases.negative_counterexample: No non-native auto-approval or duplicate confirmation

cases.title: Cross-company isolation
cases.given: Two companies share partner/order text
cases.positive_expected: Only exact company evidence binds
cases.negative_counterexample: Company-less ambiguous item cannot link

cases.title: PO-only stock evidence
cases.given: PO receipt but no real picking yet
cases.positive_expected: PO-scoped inbox evidence pending picking
cases.negative_counterexample: Invented load/stock receipt rejected

cases.title: One original many links
cases.given: One document cites two legitimate loads
cases.positive_expected: One native original, two exact typed evidence links
cases.negative_counterexample: No duplicate original and no single-pointer loss

cases.title: Alias ambiguous inbox
cases.given: Incoming alias file has two same-partner candidates
cases.positive_expected: Unlinked with one Activity
cases.negative_counterexample: Never select newest open transaction

cases.title: Single verification writer
cases.given: Unverified document gets native tag
cases.positive_expected: Business verified stays false pending authorized verification
cases.negative_counterexample: Native tag/write cannot mark verified

cases.title: Internal Request only
cases.given: Supplier missing file; internal staff request created
cases.positive_expected: Internal placeholder and one Activity; Linda external Mail only
cases.negative_counterexample: No native Documents external request invitation

cases.title: Verified Request completion
cases.given: File uploaded into internal Request
cases.positive_expected: Stay open until exact verified current evidence
cases.negative_counterexample: Upload alone cannot close requested evidence

cases.title: Supplier doc SLA
cases.given: Actual pickup Friday; supplier doc missing
cases.positive_expected: First BD due Monday; +5 after pickup; one external touch
cases.negative_counterexample: Transaction create_date cannot anchor clock

cases.title: Carrier doc SLA
cases.given: Actual pickup Friday, CST missing
cases.positive_expected: First BD due Tuesday, +6 escalate; no invoice blocker
cases.negative_counterexample: Scale tag cannot prove certified CST or penalty

cases.title: Buyer doc SLA
cases.given: Actual delivery Friday, Receiving missing
cases.positive_expected: First BD due Monday; +5 escalate, quantity scoped
cases.negative_counterexample: Supplier pickup cannot anchor buyer timer

cases.title: No duplicate reminder
cases.given: Two same-minute crons after due
cases.positive_expected: One outgoing intent and one internal Activity
cases.negative_counterexample: Concurrent jobs cannot send two notices

cases.title: Distinct readiness cadence
cases.given: Supplier not READY, no document yet due
cases.positive_expected: Monday local status request only
cases.negative_counterexample: Cannot replace it with +1 BD postpickup document chase

cases.title: Carrier ACK
cases.given: Carrier packet actually sent at T
cases.positive_expected: T+2h reminder and T+4h escalation; one packet
cases.negative_counterexample: Reservation/queue time or four-hour packet resend invalid

cases.title: No assigned dispatch
cases.given: Picking moves to assigned but custodian not READY
cases.positive_expected: No dispatch packet or dispatch_sent stamp
cases.negative_counterexample: Assigned state never triggers carrier mail

cases.title: Dropship report redaction
cases.given: Confirmed native dropship PO with buyer destination
cases.positive_expected: Supplier QWeb variant omits buyer identity; lawful PO route preserved
cases.negative_counterexample: Default report leaks buyer address or blanket route ban

cases.title: No native confirmation duplicates
cases.given: SO action_confirm send_email True in off, shadow, live
cases.positive_expected: Exactly one authorized sender per mode
cases.negative_counterexample: Legacy plus native plus Linda triplicate prohibited

cases.title: Personal server throttle
cases.given: Personal mail server owner rate limit defers outgoing mail
cases.positive_expected: No SMTP attempt recorded; queue remains retryable
cases.negative_counterexample: Deferral must not become unknown delivery

cases.title: Unknown SMTP outcome
cases.given: Actual SMTP disconnect after possible delivery
cases.positive_expected: Unknown until explicit recovery; no automatic retry
cases.negative_counterexample: Unknown cannot become sent or be blindly duplicated

cases.title: Native MIME reply ancestry
cases.given: Parallel requests; original message references one
cases.positive_expected: Candidate binds exact known request/revision
cases.negative_counterexample: Most recent chatter or plain From cannot authenticate

cases.title: Native AI absent
cases.given: Free-form reply with AI module unverified
cases.positive_expected: ai_not_run/unresolved; no business changes
cases.negative_counterexample: No fallback custom inference or fabricated AI proof

cases.title: Native AI adversarial
cases.given: Installed Manager chooses Worker with malicious stale company args
cases.positive_expected: Worker rejects before any business writes
cases.negative_counterexample: AI cannot change READY/rate/stock/posting

cases.title: Partial buyer receipt
cases.given: Buyer report covers 40% actual delivery
cases.positive_expected: Verify covered quantity only
cases.negative_counterexample: Whole load invoicing/close cannot infer 100%

cases.title: CST independent
cases.given: Buyer Receiving verified, carrier CST absent
cases.positive_expected: Buyer eligible per scoped rule; carrier document claim stays open
cases.negative_counterexample: CST missing does not auto post 150 or globally block close

cases.title: No financial auto-post
cases.given: Document verified, compliance recompute, Linda response
cases.positive_expected: No account.move.action_post or adjustment
cases.negative_counterexample: Computation cannot create/post invoices/credits/penalties

cases.title: QuickBooks settlement remains
cases.given: Preapproved QB-exit pending, invoice exists
cases.positive_expected: Odoo does not collect/mark paid by inference
cases.negative_counterexample: No Odoo bank dunning dual-write before cutover

cases.title: Weights are distinct
cases.given: Supplier weight differs from buyer and certified scale
cases.positive_expected: AP supplier, AR buyer, scale reference; >5% review
cases.negative_counterexample: No final_weight auto substitution or AI-extracted money

cases.title: Original history preserved
cases.given: Old import document or superseded document exists
cases.positive_expected: Historical source kept without current verification
cases.negative_counterexample: Old bytes not resurrected, no historic live chase

cases.title: Cancel/reopen notice sequence
cases.given: Cancel sent issue and reconfirm same terms
cases.positive_expected: Historical party notice once, then one new release
cases.negative_counterexample: New issue cannot overtake unsent cancellation notice

cases.title: BRS-only install inert
cases.given: Only BRS repo files installed
cases.positive_expected: No Odoo model/XML/cron/finance change
cases.negative_counterexample: No live send/stock/QB operation authorized by install

cases.title: Source byte preservation
cases.given: Install proposal onto exact #305 descendant
cases.positive_expected: 7 original BRS and rules.json bytes untouched
cases.negative_counterexample: Reject stale parent, altered old source, wrong branch
